# Pinned AutoTemplate core

The other files in this directory are unmodified copies of 24 files from
https://github.com/Lung-Yi/AutoTemplate at commit
`6b17ea08cc3dded90a9eee8e25b74e8a60e4cb94` (MIT License, see `LICENSE`;
Chen and Li, *J. Cheminform.* 16, 74 (2024),
https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-024-00869-2). `docs/environment.yml` is upstream's own.
The upstream README is omitted; the original execution provenance records
still include its hash as a historical record.

`upstream_manifest.json` lists each file with its upstream Git blob SHA-1;
`../source_mapping/verify_provenance.py` checks them. Upstream mixes CRLF and
LF line endings, so `.gitattributes` stores this directory without
line-ending conversion.
